follow-on: the header names d71061622 as the revision measured, yet the log records no measurement; the head arm was re-run to repair the header revision and the process was terminated (resume-2.stderr.log) before it produced output, so a log that names a revision it never measured reads as evidence about that commit.

follow-on: the mutation logs name revision 2bb438fe and their tracebacks sit one line above the committed head (138/174 here against 139/175 at d7106162), so the control was taken against a working tree that differs by a line from the landed commit; the control direction holds but the log does not name the content it ran.

follow-on: the assertion compares the coverage result's plan_fingerprint against fingerprint, the value the test itself computed and handed to the store at :171, so the compared value is not independent of the input and its sensitivity rests on the record set being empty when a form is dropped, which coverage-mutation.log demonstrates rather than the comparison itself.
